<!-- pr-reviewer: 1253641ee0b7c7a3327c6d8e0a9496003c7e5461 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- The straight lead stays the default and byte for byte. `wire_contour_arcs_led` keeps the default path; the new motion test pins the equality.
- The radius rule is one shared check at the command door (`lead_arc_radius_refusal` in `wire_gate`, after `condition_of`), used by create, edit, paste and the retool path, plus the generator's own check for a loaded file.
- The UI toggle seeds the default radius, the row is hidden when the lead is off, and Apply rides the undoable `EditOperationParams` (test pinned).
- The conflict with newer main was resolved with both sides kept; the new test stands in `wire_page_tests.rs`.

Results (head `1253641ee`)
- Self-hosted runner `pr-test #4002 1253641ee`: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45644261807 - main `138a592a1` (trial merge on the runner). Trial merge: clean. Quick gate: 772 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (79 min wall). Not a read-only PR: refused-file check passed. Head check: passed. Clippy step failed on the runner with `cargo-clippy` missing for the runner toolchain - an environment gap, not a code finding.
- Locally (worktree, PR head): `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean (motion 1m 20s, app 2m 05s, ui 1m 54s).
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, local worktree on the PR head, 6 jobs): 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (motion lib 57s, motion adaptive_troch_island 53s, adaptive_troch_neck 18s, adaptive_troch_parallel 11s, app pocket_pass_start 2s; light build 327s), wall 7.8 min.

Targeted tests
- Example catalog suites ran in the runner quick gate: example_catalog 28s, example_catalog_adaptive 1s, example_catalog_edge_work 1s, each ok. The touched suites ran too: wire_dxf_selection 4s, mcp_wire_contour 1s, ui suites lib 82s, motion lib 53s - all ok.
- P6 PR: no heavy step owed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` is a process file and the body declares `Process change: yes`; no edit to `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- `wire_op.rs` is over 400 lines (now 518; main is 507, the PR adds 11) - noted, not blocking. `mcp/job.rs` is 423 lines on the head, 4 under main - no growth. Both pre-date the PR.
- No snapshot PNGs changed; all four new NC goldens are new files and their geometry was read against the lead construction.
- The author would not have these programs exercised on a physical control; the goldens are synthetic.
- The runner's trial merge was taken against main 138a592a; main advanced (the merged #4019, wire model arcs, then docs) to 267ee5096 meanwhile. GitHub reports the PR CLEAN / MERGEABLE against the current main, and a local trial merge of the head against the current main wrote tree 7021e14d with no conflicts - the arc-lead refusal (`lead_arc_refusal` + the `lead_arc_radius.is_some()` guard in `generate_wire`) is still in place and the model-arcs route (#3215) is untouched by it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
